communityActivitySubtitle: Recent reviews and ratings from across the community. Discovery here happens through people, not an algorithm.
feedPreviewEmpty: No recent activity from people you follow yet.

anonSubtagline: Log every album without having to judge it. Rate it with stars or from 1 to 100 whenever you want, and discover music through people, not algorithms.
heroLine1: A diary of everything you listen to.
heroLine2: And of what others are hearing.
feature1Body: Every listen goes into your diary with zero friction — first listen, relisten, rediscovery — plus private notes if you want.
feature2Body: Half-stars from 0.5 to 5 and an optional 1 to 100 score. An expression of identity, not an objective average.
feature3Body: Comment on artists, albums and songs. Here a review is content in itself, not just another data point.
feature4Body: Mark your favorite artists, records and songs, and choose who can see them.
feature5Body: Curated collections with manual ordering and the visibility you want: private, followers, or public.
feature6Body: Vinyl, CDs and cassettes with edition, pressing, condition and format detail, plus a free note.
feature7Body: An explicit, one-way graph. See what they listen to, rate and comment on. Discovery through people, never an algorithm.
feature8Body: Real feats, collaborations, editions and remasters. It tells the person from the band: Pink Floyd ↔ Roger Waters.
feature9Body: Public or private profile, per-item audience, follow requests and blocks. You decide what's shared.
popularCommentsEmpty: No comments of this kind yet.
releasesFollowHint: Follow artists, or rate them and add them to favorites, and their releases will show up here.
anonClosingTitle: Your listening history starts with an account.
sampleAria: Example diary entry: {title}, {stars}, score {score} out of 100
featuredAlbumsDescription: Curated selections to get into the catalog without knowing where to start.
topRatedDescription: What the people logging their listens rate highest.
communityPeopleHint: Find people and follow what they listen to.
featuresDescription: Listening never requires an opinion: rating and commenting are separate layers, whenever you want.
releasesDescription: What just came out and what is coming, from the most-listened artists. The calendar updates itself.
anonClosingBody: No streaks, no backlog, no pressure. Just what you listened to and what you thought of it.
heroTitle: What did you listen to today?
logFieldHint: Pick the album and it goes into your diary; context and rating are optional.

followingDescription: Listens, ratings and reviews from the people you chose to follow.
